Extracts og:video, og:audio, and og:locale:alternate metadata

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.metadata().ogVideo() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().ogAudio() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().ogLocaleAlternates() as Any)
```
